title: refactor(driver-sql): codemod pilot — generated, byte-identity-proved section split of sql-driver.ts (#29520)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi9paTx1Lu8ENYwwssthfK3h)_

Fixes #29520

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:codemod `scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs` 生成的 `sql-driver.ts` 拆分。54 个方法体移入 18 个分节模块,127/129 个类外顶层声明移入叶模块 `sql-driver-top-level.ts`。`check-tenant-chokepoint` 扫描全部非测试 `sql-driver-*.ts`,其 dispatch-gates 声明补上 main 新增的 `sql-driver-balanced-group.ts`,自测失败时直接写出要加或删的条目。按裁决 6597555122 第 3 点,按路径读取 `sql-driver.ts` 的读者跟随代码扩到新模块:`sql-driver-compile-refusal-seam.test.ts` 的 `sources` 加入叶模块,`logger-receiver-detach.test.ts` 的 pin ③ 改为列目录读全部 `sql-driver*.ts`,liveness 台账的一条锚点改指叶模块,ADR-0053 锚点登记为三个新模块各加一条。根 `package.json` 加入 devDependency `ts-morph` `^28.0.0`(#29711 后已无包声明它),codemod 从根清单解析。生成文件未手改。
- 为什么改:落实 #29520 第三轮(裁决 6597555122 选项 A)。测试读取清单加入叶模块后,`sql-driver.ts` 从 18,334 行降到 12,460 行,低于 13,000 行的门槛。
- 风险与回滚:纯搬移。54/54 方法体、127/127 顶层声明逐字节相同;撤销拆分可逐字节还原 base;三套驱动测试计数与 base 相同(driver-sql 多 1 条,是 pin ③ 新增的下限用例);门禁读数 base = head。打包 `.d.ts` 按 6441032442 B 的第二归一化判通过,四项读数全部相等,阳性对照抓到去掉的 `private`。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:① 下方「按路径读取 `sql-driver.ts` 的读者」表(哪些读者跟随了代码);② `scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs` 的 `CLASS_PATH_READER_NEEDLES`;③ `.d.ts` 读数表。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` 后运行 `node scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs --verify --base 0b5b176038`,预期 `54/54 moved bodies identical`、`127/127 moved top-level declarations identical`、`18334 -> 12460 lines`,退出码 0。
- 需要你做的:无新裁决。超过 3,000 行,按四件套交接,待您批准后在您定的窗口落地;本 PR 保持草稿。

## What changes

- **`scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs`** (round 3): the three seam-test needles move from `PATH_READER_NEEDLES` into a new `CLASS_PATH_READER_NEEDLES` table: `unsupportedFilterError(`, `withheldFilterError(` and `.INVALID_FILTER`.
  - The reader of these needles now reads the leaf, so a top-level declaration carrying one moves to it. That frees the 29 refusal builders and the 6 declarations that close over them.
  - A method carrying one still stays on the class. The test reads no section module, and it pins `SqlDriver.resolveWithheldFilterRefusal` by name.
  - Measured: dropping the three needles outright moves that method too (55 methods, 12,449 lines), and the test's enumeration would then go red.
  - A stale class needle refuses, as a stale needle does.
  - Two mutants are each refused with 2 failures: the method rule removed, and the class needles applied to top-level declarations.
  - Review fixes: `--help` / `-h` is answered before any guard (it was refused on a split tree), and `--dts` counts a line-count change as `diff` does (it read 0), naming the count in `rawDiffMethod`.
  - `--self-test`: 45 cases in 5 pinned batteries. A mutant of each review fix is refused.
- **Root `package.json` and `pnpm-lock.yaml`**: `ts-morph` `^28.0.0` joins the root devDependencies, beside `typescript`, `yaml` and `semver`. The codemod now resolves it from the root manifest.
  - Why: #29711 removed `ts-morph` from `@objectstack/cli`, and no workspace package declares it. The codemod resolved it through the CLI, so on a fresh `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` its `--verify` and `--self-test` exited 2.
  - The lockfile was written by `pnpm install --lockfile-only` (+25 lines, nothing else re-resolved). It adds `ts-morph@28.0.0`, `@ts-morph/common@0.29.0` and `code-block-writer@13.0.3`. `@ts-morph/common`'s `minimatch` resolves to the `10.2.6` already in the tree, under the existing `minimatch@<11.0.0` override.
  - Proved from clean: every `node_modules` removed, then `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`. With only `ts-morph` set aside, the script exits 2 and names the root manifest.
- **`scripts/check-tenant-chokepoint.mjs`**: `DECLARED_WATCH_HINTS` gains `sql-driver-balanced-group.ts`, which #29911 added on main. The scan lists the directory, so it already read the module. The self-test's coupling asserts now name each missing or extra entry, and the one edit that fixes it.
  - Why the list stays literal: the dispatch-gates extractor does accept `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-*.ts` and judges it as a pattern. Through `hintCovers`, though, it covers 31 seam modules and 234 `sql-driver-*.test.ts` files, plus any `.d.ts`. A hint has no negation, and `?` and `[…]` are not admitted, so no spelling covers the modules and leaves the tests out. The gate's docblock records this.
  - Before the literal was added, the self-test failed with: `Fix: add 'packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-balanced-group.ts' to DECLARED_WATCH_HINTS in this gate`.
- **`sql-driver-compile-refusal-seam.test.ts`**: `sources` gains `sql-driver-top-level.ts` under a `[#29520 codemod]` comment, in the same form as hand cuts 13, 15 and 16. The enumeration prose names the leaf too.
  - This migrates a path reader (#25521 ask 3). It is not an edit of generated output.
  - Ablation: without the new line the test fails 3 of 115 at head (the positive control and both enumeration sets). With it, 115/115 pass.
- **`logger-receiver-detach.test.ts` pin ③**: it read `sql-driver.ts` only and asserts an absence, so it stayed green while 3 of the host's 21 log-channel calls moved out. It now lists its directory and reads every non-test `sql-driver*.ts` (a named list would rot at the next regeneration), with a floor case that the listing finds more than the host. It reads 55 calls at base and at head. Ablation: a planted `(this.logger.error ?? this.logger.warn)(` in `sql-driver-internal-helpers.ts` turns it red; the old host-only pin stays green on the same tree.
- **`packages/spec/liveness/query.json`**: the one anchor whose symbol moved, `unsupportedAggregationFilterError`, now cites `sql-driver-top-level.ts`. Nothing else in the ledger changes; the other nine driver-sql anchors still resolve in `sql-driver.ts`.
- **`scripts/adr-anchors/`**: three new ADR-0053 entries, for `sql-driver-sqlite-serialisation.ts` (`formatOutput`'s folds), `sql-driver-filter-helpers.ts` (`presentReadValue`'s datetime and audit arms) and `sql-driver-top-level.ts` (the fold helpers), in the shape #25521 cut 8 gave `sql-driver-schema-sync.ts`. 18 of the host's 33 ADR-0053 citations moved with that code; the host entry stays for the stubs and the 15 left. Removing ADR-0053 from one module turns `check:adr-anchors` red.
- **Unchanged from round 2:**
  - lever (a): section modules may import values from `sql-driver.ts`. This round it exports no staying helper, because every helper the moved bodies read now sits in the leaf;
  - lever (b): one leaf that never imports back;
  - the stub host's bound `getBuilder`;
  - the widened `check-tenant-chokepoint`;
  - the `no-yield` rule;
  - no re-indentation.
- **The generated split:** `--write` on origin/main, unedited. On the latest merge base `0b5b176038`, #29911 changed `sql-driver.ts` (input sha256 `2d2ebebdba87…`). The resolution took main's `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src` and kept this branch's two test files, then regenerated. The same 54 methods and 127 declarations move, and the result differs from the previous head only by #29911's own change. It produces `sql-driver.ts`, the leaf, and 18 section modules:
  - `lifecycle`, `crud`, `sequence-semantics`, `bulk-operations`, `aggregation`, `distinct`;
  - `window-functions`, `query-plan`, `schema-sync-section`, `rotation`, `managed-drift`, `internal-helpers`;
  - `filter-helpers`, `field-mapping`, `window-function-builder`, `column-creation`, `database-helpers`, `sqlite-serialisation`.

## Measurements

| Reading | Value |
|:--|:--|
| `sql-driver.ts` lines (`wc -l`) | 18,334 → **12,460** (−5,874). Bar: below 13,000. **Met** |
| Methods | 54 of 254 move (2,596 body lines out, 616 stub lines in, 36 import lines) |
| Top-level declarations | 127 of 129 move (3,784 lines with their docblocks). 2 stay, both `path-reader`: `JSON_COLUMN_TYPES` and `MEDIA_ID_VARCHAR_CHARS`, which the cli pins read |
| Leaf / new files | `sql-driver-top-level.ts` 3,999 lines; all 19 new files 9,575 lines |
| Byte-identity | 54/54 bodies, 127/127 top-level declarations identical; undoing the split rebuilds the base byte-for-byte |
| Determinism | output tree sha256 `088547bdc1b4e152d6298d4a1d33b007eec27871e179716a298944b673984170` on three runs: `--write` in the worktree and two plan runs on main's unsplit text. Input sha256 `2d2ebebdba87…` |
| Chokepoint readings | base (main, widened gate): 24 `getBuilder()` bindings, 21 read doors, 3 inserts, 4 tenant predicates, 0 D8 arms across 15 files. Head: identical across 34 files |
| Export lists | `.d.ts` 92 = 92; runtime CJS 59 = 59 and ESM 59 = 59 (CJS = ESM) |
| Changed lines | 17,073 (+10,528 / −6,545, 30 files) |

### Readers of `sql-driver.ts` by path (ruling 6597555122 point 3)

| Reader | Asserts | Host matches moved | Now |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| seam test enumeration | exact set | 26 / 28 | reads the leaf |
| logger-receiver-detach pin ③ | absence | 3 / 21 | reads every `sql-driver*.ts` |
| `check-tenant-chokepoint` | absence + floors | 18 / 24 | reads 34 files (round 2) |
| liveness `#anchor` citations | presence | 1 / 14 | re-pointed |
| ADR-0053 anchor registry | presence anywhere in file | 18 / 33 | 3 new entries |
| 5 cli pins, `check-keyed-text-bounds` | presence (slices) | 0 | held by needles / pins |
| `check-durability-degradation-log-level` | absence (same-file helper) | 2 / 9 (to `sql-driver-column-creation.ts:53` and `:84`; the host still counts 9 because two new stubs forward) | repo-wide scan, green |
| ADR / QA `#symbol` anchors, `check-object-def-param-keys`, cli test cache inputs | presence | 0 | unchanged |

### `.d.ts`: ruling 6441032442 item 1, second normalisation, with ruling 6597555122's header clarification

The normaliser is `dtsnorm.mjs`, sha256 `9e3ca459fb22015c7e77e4576b564ca46076cfd0f366dc00dcec521274f8e911`. The devx lane rewrote it from the ruling's text. It is a report reading, ⛔ not in `scripts/` (item 3). It does three things:

- It splits each file into top-level statements with the TypeScript API. Each statement keeps its attached comments byte for byte.
- A leading comment separated by a blank line is a detached file-level comment. It leaves the statement stream and is compared on its own as a multiset, so its text still must not change.
- It sorts the statements and the specifier lists inside `import { }` / `export { }`, and masks chunk hashes. driver-sql emits no chunk.

Base is main `0b5b176038`'s unsplit `src`, built. Head is `5f30cf9f2c`, built. The readings are the same as round 3's, hash for hash. Each reading below is the same for `index.d.ts` and `index.d.mts`.

| Reading | Base | Head | Verdict |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Raw sha256 | `0f33bf3f…` | `69d9162d…` | differ; raw diff 19 lines, `wc -l` 8,846 → 8,847 |
| **Normalised bytes** | `468260520fcc1ac2…` | `468260520fcc1ac2…` | **identical** |
| **Declared-surface digest** (100 declarations, 585 lines) | `50e5e5be3c1d…` | `50e5e5be3c1d…` | **equal** |
| **Statement multiset** | 106 | 106 | **equal**: only in base 0, only in head 0. Before the specifier sort it is 2 / 2, the two `@objectstack/spec` imports |
| **Export set** | 92 | 92 | **equal**; import specifier set 17 = 17 |
| Detached comments | 2 | 2 | equal texts. The "SQL Driver for ObjectStack" header now sits before `declare class SqlDriver`, which ruling 6597555122 does not count |

**Positive control (catches a dropped `private`).** I dropped `private` from one moved member's stub, `compileFilters`, rebuilt, ran the normaliser on head against control, then restored and rebuilt. The rebuilt head `.d.ts` is byte-identical to the earlier head. The control is caught on three readings:

- normalised hashes differ: `468260520fcc…` vs `73e89389695f…`;
- surface digests differ: `50e5e5be3c1d…` vs `acf70f0378d0…`. It names `PropertyDeclaration [private] compileFilters` → `MethodDeclaration [] compileFilters`;
- the statement multiset is 1 / 1.

The normaliser exits 1 on both files. Its `--self-test` passes 8 cases, among them a member reordered inside its class and a changed header text, both refused.

**Premises.**

- P2: driver-sql `exports` is `.` only. It names `dist/index.*` and no chunk.
- P3: `git grep 'driver-sql/dist' -- scripts package.json` finds 0 hits.
- (e) Dependents are green against the head dist: the driver-turso and driver-sqlite-wasm typecheck and suites ran after the head build.

<details><summary>Why most methods stay (counted per method; one method can carry several)</summary>

`already-moved` 78 · `no-yield` 55 · `non-public-static` 47 · `parameter-shape` 21 · `this-write` 19 · `path-reader` 18 · `no-section` 14 · `static` 11 · `comment-in-parameters` 7 · `field-call` 6 · `inferred-return-type` 6 · `type-parameters` 3 · `name-taken` 3 · `reserved-name` 1. The full table is the script's plan output.

</details>

## Tests

Every run below is at head `5f30cf9f2c` on merge base `0b5b176038`, after every `node_modules` was removed and `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` re-ran. Each ran under one `os-verify-lock` hold (VERDICT command-exit 0). The base runs used main's unsplit `src`, built and then restored in place; status was clean afterwards.

- Type-check: driver-sql, driver-turso and driver-sqlite-wasm each exit 0.
- `@objectstack/driver-sql test`: exit 0 at both. 250 files (238 passed, 12 skipped). Base 4074 tests (3858 passed, 216 skipped); head 4075 (3859 passed, 216 skipped): the +1 is pin ③'s new floor case.
- `@objectstack/driver-turso test`: exit 0 at both. 96 files; 2530 tests (2496 passed, 34 skipped). Base = head.
- `@objectstack/driver-sqlite-wasm test`: exit 0 at both. 40 files; 750 tests passed. Base = head.
- The five `packages/cli` pin tests that read `sql-driver.ts` by path exit 0:
  - unit: 4 files, 62 tests;
  - integration (`generate-string-family-width`): 1 file, 30 tests.
- `sql-driver-compile-refusal-seam.test.ts`: 115/115. With the new `sources` line removed, 3 tests fail (the ablation above).
- `logger-receiver-detach.test.ts`: 12/12; the planted shape fails it (ablation above).
- `packages/spec` `check-liveness.test.ts` 74/74 and `check:liveness` exit 0.
- Codemod: `--self-test` 45 cases in 5 batteries; `--verify --base 0b5b176038` exits 0 (54/54, 127/127, 12,460 lines); two plan runs on base's unsplit text give tree `088547bd…` both times, byte-identical; `--help` on the split tree exits 0.
- `check-tenant-chokepoint` `--self-test` and main run exit 0. `check:adr-anchors` and `check:adr-symbol-anchors` exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

1. **The bar is met: 12,460 lines.** Round 3 measured 12,456 on the older base; #29911 added 4 lines to code that stays on the class.
2. **The three needles still bind methods.** That is what keeps the test green (see What changes). Literally deleting them would move `resolveWithheldFilterRefusal` into `sql-driver-filter-helpers.ts`, which the test does not read.
3. **`.d.ts`** passes ruling 6441032442 B's second normalisation on all four readings, with the control caught. Ruling 6348891160's union-order bar alone still reads FAIL on these files. Under 6441032442 item 1, that is the case the second normalisation exists for.
4. **Full `pnpm build`** exits 2 in `@object-ui/app-shell` (`Cannot find module '@object-ui/mobile'`), outside this change. Every driver and cli closure used here builds.
5. **Size.** 17,073 changed lines is over the 3,000 threshold. Per ruling 6597555122 the PR takes the four-piece hand-off and a maintainer approval, and lands in the window the maintainer sets. It stays a draft.
6. **`skip-changeset`:** the `.d.ts` meets item 1 by ruling 6441032442, so per item 4 it takes no changeset.

## Verification

- Byte-identity: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, then `node scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs --verify --base 0b5b176038`.
- `.d.ts`: build `@objectstack/driver-sql` at main's unsplit `src` and at head. Then run `node dtsnorm.mjs --diff BASE/index.d.ts HEAD/index.d.ts`, and the same for `.d.mts`. Expect exit 0 and `"pass": true`. The #29520 report gives the normaliser's path and sha256.
- Chokepoint: `node scripts/check-tenant-chokepoint.mjs` prints the readings line.
- Re-running in the landing window: merge the latest `main` and take `main`'s `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src`, keeping this branch's `sql-driver-compile-refusal-seam.test.ts` and `logger-receiver-detach.test.ts`. Then run `--write` and commit. If a regeneration moves different code, re-check the reader table above.

<details><summary>Gates at head 5f30cf9f2c</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives 92 families at `5f30cf9f2c` on merge base `0b5b176038`, the same list as at `5b19e9ac05`. Each was run alone after the fresh install, with its exit captured before any pipe: 92 exit 0, `check:tenant-chokepoint` among them.
- The `--ran` reconciliation reads 92 derived, 92 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, exit 0.
- Not measured here: the OSV-Scanner job. CI runs it base-relative because the lockfile changed, and the local proxy refuses `api.osv.dev`. The only advisory-bearing package the three lockfile additions reach is `minimatch` 10.2.6, which is already in the merge base's lockfile and already covered by the `GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249` exemption.
- Also run: the codemod's `--dts` (ruling 6348891160's bar alone reads FAIL, as before), the seam and logger tests together (127/127), and spec `check:liveness`.
- `check:commit-card-trailers` passed on every push.

</details>
